note: 2026 statewide ballot measures; results wired near Election Day.

races.title: Amendment 1
races.name: Alabama Amendment 1, Elections for Lieutenant Governor Vacancies and Legislative Authority Over Salaries Amendment
races.subject: State executive elections
races.description: Require the office of lieutenant governor to be filled by election if a vacancy occurs more than 60 days before the next general election

races.title: Amendment 2
races.name: Alabama Amendment 2, School District Consolidation Process Amendment
races.subject: Local government organization; Public education governance
races.description: Establish a process for consolidating two or more county school districts

races.title: Amendment 3
races.name: Alabama Amendment 3, Require Pledge of Allegiance and Allow Student-Led Prayer in Public Schools Amendment
races.subject: State flags, symbols, and holidays; Religion in public schools
races.description: Require public schools to conduct the pledge of allegiance each day, and allow student-led prayer to be conducted

races.title: Amendment 4
races.name: Alabama Amendment 4, Broadcast The Star-Spangled Banner in Public Schools Amendment
races.subject: State flags, symbols, and holidays; Public education governance
races.description: Require all public schools to broadcast or arrange for the performance of the first stanza of the Star-Spangled Banner at least once per week

races.title: Ballot Measure 2
races.name: Alaska Ballot Measure 2, Repeal Top-Four Ranked-Choice Voting Initiative
races.subject: Ranked-choice voting; Primary election systems; Campaign finance
races.description: Repeal the top-four ranked-choice voting (RCV) system that was adopted in 2020

races.title: Ballot Measure 3
races.name: Alaska Ballot Measure 3, Citizenship Voting Requirement Initiative
races.subject: Citizenship voting requirements
races.description: Amend state law to provide that "Only a person who is a citizen of the United States" may vote in any election

races.title: Proposition 141
races.name: Arizona Proposition 141, Prohibit Taxes or Fees on Miles Traveled in Motor Vehicle Amendment
races.subject: Transportation taxes and fees; Vehicle and driver regulations
races.description: Prohibit the government from imposing taxes or fees based on vehicle miles traveled and from enacting rules to monitor or limit vehicle miles traveled without the person’s consent

races.title: Proposition 142
races.name: Arizona Proposition 142, Prohibit Race- or Ethnicity-Based Preferential Treatment, Public Education Offices, and Disciplinary Policies Amendment
races.subject: Higher education governance; Public education governance; Constitutional rights; Race and ethnicity issues; Affirmative action
races.description: Prohibit the government from requiring an individual to endorse preferential treatment toward or discrimination against an individual on the basis of race or ethnicity

races.title: Proposition 144
races.name: Arizona Proposition 144, Voter Identification and Citizenship Voting Requirements Amendment
races.subject: Absentee and mail voting; Election administration and governance; Voter ID policy; Early voting; Citizenship voting requirements; Campaign finance
races.description: Make a number of changes to the state's election laws, including specifying that only citizens may vote in any Arizona election and requiring voters to show a government-issued ID to cast a ballot

races.title: Proposition 316
races.name: Arizona Proposition 316, Limit Local Tax Rate on Groceries to 2% of Base Price and Require Voter Approval to Increase Tax Rate Measure
races.subject: Food and beverage taxes; Ballot measure process; Sales taxes
races.description: Prohibit local government from imposing or increasing a tax on the sale of food items without voter approval and cap the tax rate at 2%

races.title: Proposition 317
races.name: Arizona Proposition 317, Designate Drug Cartels as Terrorist Organizations and Require State DHS to Address Threats Measure
races.subject: Criminal sentencing; Immigration policy
races.description: Declare drug cartels to be terrorist organizations

races.title: Proposition 318
races.name: Arizona Proposition 318, Require All Schools and Athletic Associations to Restrict Sports Participation and Access to Private Spaces Based on Sex Measure
races.subject: LGBTQ issues; Athletics and sports; Public education governance; Sex and gender issues
races.description: Prohibit schools and athletic associations from allowing a student, athlete, employee, or other individual from using a restroom, locker room, shower room, or other private space that is not designated for their sex

races.title: Proposition 319
races.name: Arizona Proposition 319, Prohibit New Photo Traffic Enforcement Systems Measure
races.subject: Law enforcement officers and departments; Vehicle and driver regulations
races.description: Prohibit the government from using traffic photo enforcement systems without voter approval

races.title: Proposition 320
races.name: Arizona Proposition 320, Require Certain School Districts to Spend 60% of Operational Spending on Direct Instruction Measure
races.subject: Public education funding; Public education governance
races.description: Require certain school districts to spend at least 60% of their budget on direct instructional expenses

races.title: Issue 1
races.name: Arkansas Issue 1, Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment
races.subject: Citizenship voting requirements
races.description: Provide that "Only a citizen of the United States ... may vote in an election in this state"

races.title: Issue 2
races.name: Arkansas Issue 2, Right to Keep and Bear Arms Amendment
races.subject: Constitutional rights; Firearms policy
races.description: Provide that the right to keep and bear arms is "a natural, fundamental, and individual right that shall not be infringed"

races.title: Issue 3
races.name: Arkansas Issue 3, Authorize Legislature to Create Programs for Economic Development Including Economic Development Districts Amendment
races.subject: Local government organization; Public economic investment policy; Local government finance and taxes
races.description: Allow the legislature to create programs, including Economic Development Districts, and make loans and grants of public money to develop the state economy

races.title: Issue 4
races.name: Arkansas Issue 4, Natural Resources Commission Bond Measure
races.subject: Bond issues; Storm infrastructure; Parks, land, and natural area conservation; Pollution, waste, and recycling policy; Sewage and stormwater; Water irrigation policy; Flood infrastructure and management
races.description: Authorize the Arkansas Natural Resources Commission to issue up to $500 million in general obligation bonds to fund water-related infrastructure projects including water treatment and transportation, waste disposal, pollution abatement, drainage, irrigation, flood control, and wetlands and aquatic resources infrastructure

races.title: Proposition 1
races.name: California Proposition 1, Veteran and Housing Assistance Programs Bond Measure
races.subject: Bond issues; Housing assistance programs
races.description: Issue $11.25 billion in bonds to fund Multifamily Housing Program, CalVet Home Loan Program, and youth housing

races.title: Proposition 2
races.name: California Proposition 2, Budget Stabilization Account Cap Increase and Gann Limit Changes Amendment
races.subject: Budget stabilization funds
races.description: Increase the Budget Stabilization Account (BSA) cap from 10% of general fund revenue to 20% and excluding deposits into the BSA from the Gann Limit

races.title: Proposition 3
races.name: California Proposition 3, Renew State Income Tax Increase for Education Funding Initiative
races.subject: Higher education funding; Public education funding; Income taxes
races.description: Renew the additional income taxes enacted with the approval of Proposition 30 in 2012 that fund education and early childhood programs.

races.title: Proposition 37
races.name: California Proposition 37, Second Mortgage Homebuyer Program and Revenue Bond Initiative
races.subject: Housing assistance programs
races.description: Establish a second mortgage homebuyer program for qualified homebuyers on qualifying homes and issue $25 billion in bonds to fund the program

races.title: Proposition 38
races.name: California Proposition 38, Immunology and Immunotherapy Research Funding Initiative
races.subject: Bond issues; Healthcare facility funding; Vaccinations and disease policy; Healthcare governance
races.description: Issue $8.4 billion in general obligation bonds to fund immunology and immunotherapy research

races.title: Proposition 39
races.name: California Proposition 39, Voter Identification, Citizenship Verification, and Registered Voter List Administration Initiative
races.subject: Election administration and governance; Voter ID policy
races.description: Require voters to present government-issued identification when casting ballots and require election officials to use government data to confirm voter citizenship and report verification rates

races.title: Proposition 4
races.name: California Proposition 4, Allow Public Financing of Election Campaigns Measure
races.subject: Election administration and governance; Campaign finance
races.description: Allow the state and local governments to create programs that provide candidates with public funds under spending limits and eligibility rules

races.title: Proposition 40
races.name: California Proposition 40, One-Time Wealth Tax for State-Funded Healthcare, Education, and Food Assistance Programs Initiative
races.subject: Income taxes; Public health insurance
races.description: Levy a one-time 5% tax on the accumulated wealth of taxpayers and trusts with covered assets valued over $1 billion to fund state health care programs, food assistance programs, and public education

races.title: Proposition 41
races.name: California Proposition 41, Prohibit Excluding New State Taxes from Spending Limit and Require Special Tax Audits Initiative
races.subject: Tax and revenue administration; Revenue and spending limits
races.description: Require state laws or ballot initiatives levying a new special tax enacted after January 1, 2026 to require the government entities or departments receiving revenue from the new tax to eliminate their lowest-performing programs and reinvest those savings in higher-performing programs

races.title: Proposition 42
races.name: California Proposition 42, Prohibit New Taxes on Retirement Holdings, Personal Assets, and Savings and Limit Retroactive Taxes Initiative
races.subject: Income taxes
races.description: Prohibit the enactment of new taxes after January 1, 2026 on ownership or accumulation of retirement holdings, individually-owned assets, and other forms of personal savings

races.title: Proposition 43
races.name: California Proposition 43, Two-Thirds Vote Requirement for Local Special Tax Initiatives and Property Tax Initiative Prohibition Amendment
races.subject: Local government finance and taxes; Ballot measure supermajority requirements
races.description: Require two-thirds vote by electorate to enact, extend, or increase local special tax initiatives and prohibit local governments and ballot initiatives from enacting ad valorem property taxes except those authorized elsewhere in the state constitution

races.title: Proposition 44
races.name: California Proposition 44, Spending Requirements for Federally Qualified Health Centers Initiative
races.subject: Business regulations; Healthcare governance
races.description: Prohibit healthcare clinics, specifically federally-qualified health centers and related organizations, from spending less than 90% of their annual revenue on mission-related purposes

races.title: Proposition 45
races.name: California Proposition 45, Changes to Environmental Review Process for Certain Projects Initiative
races.subject: Administrative powers and rulemaking; Land use and development policy
races.description: Establish timelines for local and state agencies to review plans and solicit public comment for essential projects, such as housing, improvements to water supply, transportation, energy, and facilities for health and public safety

races.title: Proposition 5
races.name: California Proposition 5, Eliminate State Officer Recall Successor Elections Amendment
races.subject: State executive branch structure; Recall process
races.description: Eliminate the successor election when a state officer is recalled, thereby leaving the office vacant until it is filled according to state law

races.title: Amendment 81
races.name: Colorado Amendment 81, Notification of U.S. Department of Homeland Security for Certain Criminal Charges and Immigration Status Initiative
races.subject: Law enforcement officers and departments; Immigration policy
races.description: Require law enforcement to notify the U.S. Department of Homeland Security when a person is charged with a crime of violence or has a prior felony conviction and the person’s immigration status cannot be determined

races.title: Amendment 82
races.name: Colorado Amendment 82, Right to Purchase and Sell Natural Gas for Cooking or Heating in Homes and Businesses Amendment
races.subject: Constitutional rights; Fossil fuel energy; Business regulations
races.description: Provide a constitutional right for consumers to purchase natural gas for cooking or heating in homes and businesses and for distributors and utilities to sell natural gas for those purposes

races.title: Amendment 83
races.name: Colorado Amendment 83, Right to Hunt and Fish Amendment
races.subject: Right to hunt and fish
races.description: Establish a right to hunt, fish, and take fish and wildlife in the state constitution, through traditional methods, and allow the state legislature and executive agencies to regulate it

races.title: Amendment 84
races.name: Colorado Amendment 84, Require Voter Identification Number for Mail-In Ballots Initiative
races.subject: Voter ID policy; Absentee and mail voting
races.description: Require voters casting ballots by mail to place their signature and some form of real ID on their ballot

races.title: Amendment 85
races.name: Colorado Amendment 85, Require Plain Language and Eighth-Grade Reading Level for Ballot Measures Initiative
races.subject: Ballot measure process; Initiative and referendum process
races.description: Require ballot questions to be in plain language, at no more than an eighth-grade reading level

races.title: Amendment 86
races.name: Colorado Amendment 86, Require Commission and Supreme Court Approval for Mid-Decade Congressional Redistricting Initiative
races.subject: Redistricting policy
races.description: Require congressional maps drawn in 2028 to be approved by both a nonpolitical commission and the state supreme court

races.title: Amendment 87
races.name: Colorado Amendment 87, Establish Graduated Income Tax and Dedicate New Revenue to Education, Healthcare, and Childcare Initiative
races.subject: Income taxes; Public assistance programs; Early childhood education; Public education funding
races.description: Establish a graduated income tax within the state

races.title: Proposition 132
races.name: Colorado Proposition 132, Penalties for Fentanyl Sale and Possession Initiative
races.subject: Drug crime policy; Criminal sentencing
races.description: Increase penalties for fentanyl-related felonies, require treatment for certain drug offenses, and limit sentencing exceptions in fentanyl-related crimes that cause another person’s death

races.title: Proposition 133
races.name: Colorado Proposition 133, Require Life in Prison for Human Trafficking of Minors Measure
races.subject: Criminal sentencing
races.description: Require life in prison without parole or release for persons convicted of human trafficking a child for sexual servitude

races.title: Proposition 134
races.name: Colorado Proposition 134, Sex Requirement for School and College Sports Initiative
races.subject: Higher education governance; Athletics and sports; LGBTQ issues; Sex and gender issues; Public education governance
races.description: Require all K-12 and collegiate school sports teams to be separated based on biological sex, unless the team is co-ed

races.title: Proposition 135
races.name: Colorado Proposition 135, Prohibit Surgeries for Treatment in Response to Minors' Perception of Sex or Gender Measure
races.subject: LGBTQ issues; Healthcare governance; Sex and gender issues
races.description: Prohibit healthcare professionals from providing surgeries to persons under age 18 for the purpose of “treatment in response to a minor’s perception of sex or gender”

races.title: Proposition 136
races.name: Colorado Proposition 136, Establish 4.4% Cap on Individual and Corporate Income Tax Rates Initiative
races.subject: Income taxes; Business taxes
races.description: Establish a 4.4% cap on individual and corporate income tax rates

races.title: Proposition 137
races.name: Colorado Proposition 137, Retain Sporting Goods Sales Tax Revenue for Conservation and Wildfire Prevention Fund Initiative
races.subject: Wildfire management; Parks, land, and natural area conservation; Restricted-use funds; Sales taxes
races.description: Allow the state to retain and spend sales tax revenue from sporting goods and equipment for water, land, forest, wildfire prevention, and outdoor recreation purposes

races.title: Proposition NN
races.name: Colorado Proposition NN, TABOR Revenue Cap Increase for K-12 Education Measure
races.subject: Public education funding; Revenue and spending limits
races.description: Increase TABOR cap and use surplus funds for K-12 education expenses

races.title: Amendment 1
races.name: Florida Amendment 1, Changes to Budget Stabilization Fund Amendment
races.subject: Budget stabilization funds
races.description: Increase the amount of funds that may be retained in the budget stabilization fund from 10% to 25% of net general revenue among other changes

races.title: Amendment 2
races.name: Florida Amendment 2, Exempt Tangible Personal Property Used for Agriculture or Agritourism from Property Taxes Amendment
races.subject: Agriculture policy; Property tax exemptions
races.description: Exempt agricultural-related tangible personal property, such as farm equipment or tools, from property taxes

races.title: Amendment 3
races.name: Florida Amendment 3, Homestead Tax Exemptions, Property Assessments, and Spending Restrictions Amendment
races.subject: Property taxes; Property tax exemptions; Local government finance and taxes; Homestead tax exemptions
races.description: Increase the homestead tax exemption, decrease the cap on how much the assessed value of non-homestead properties can increase, and limit how municipalities can spend property tax revenue

races.title: Amendment 1
races.name: Georgia Amendment 1, Increase Acre Limit for Agriculture and Timber Conservation Use Property Tax Classification Measure
races.subject: Property tax exemptions; Agriculture policy; Forestry and timber
races.description: Increase the maximum acreage of agricultural and timber property that can be classified as bona fide conservation use property, which is taxed at 40% of the land's value, from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres

races.title: Amendment 2
races.name: Georgia Amendment 2, Require Nonpartisan Elections for Probate Judges Measure
races.subject: State judicial selection
races.description: Require that probate judges be elected on a nonpartisan basis

races.title: Amendment 3
races.name: Georgia Amendment 3, Authorize Creation of Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund Measure
races.subject: Restricted-use funds
races.description: Allow the state legislature to create and dedicate revenue to a fund titled the Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund

races.title: Question 1
races.name: Hawaii Question 1, Increase Time for Senate to Act on Judicial Appointments Amendment
races.subject: State legislative processes and sessions; State judicial selection
races.description: Increase the timeframe for the Senate to consider and act on appointments of judges and justices from 30 days to 60 days for appointments made between April 1 and December 31 when the Senate is not in regular session or is soon to adjourn the regular session

races.title: Question 2
races.name: Hawaii Question 2, Authorize Resilient Infrastructure for Shelter and Equity (RISE) Bonds Amendment
races.subject: Housing development funding; Local government finance and taxes; Public economic investment policy; Bond issues; Bond issue requirements
races.description: Authorize the state legislature to empower the counties and municipalities of the state to issue housing infrastructure growth bonds for specified public works, public improvements, and community development

races.title: HJR 4
races.name: Idaho HJR 4, Grant Legislature Exclusive Authority and Prohibit Citizen-Initiated Measures on Marijuana, Narcotics, and Psychoactive Substances Amendment
races.subject: Marijuana laws; State legislative authority; Psychedelic substances laws; Drug crime policy; Initiative and referendum process
races.description: Provide that only the state legislature has the authority to legalize marijuana, narcotics, or other psychoactive substances

races.title: HJR 6
races.name: Idaho HJR 6, English as Official State Language Amendment
races.subject: English language policy
races.description: Add constitutional language designating English as the official language of Idaho

races.title: Official State Gun Question
races.name: Idaho Official State Gun Question
races.subject: State flags, symbols, and holidays
races.description: Ask voters to choose the official state gun of Idaho

races.title: Proposition 1
races.name: Idaho Proposition 1, Reproductive Freedom and Privacy Act Initiative
races.subject: Abortion policy
races.description: Provide, in statute, that people have a right to reproductive freedom and privacy, defined as "the right to make and carry out one’s own reproductive decisions"

races.title: Public Question 1
races.name: Indiana Public Question 1, Bailable Offenses and Substantial Risk Standard Amendment
races.subject: Criminal trials; Bail policy
races.description: Provide for the denial of bail when the accused is found to pose a substantial risk to another person

races.title: Public Question 2
races.name: Indiana Public Question 2, Residency Requirements for City and Town Court Judges Amendment
races.subject: Local government officials and elections; State judicial selection
races.description: Require city and town court judges to reside in either the county where the court is located or the bordering county closest to the court

races.title: Amendment 1
races.name: Iowa Amendment 1, Two-Thirds Legislative Vote Requirement for Income Tax Increase Bills Amendment
races.subject: State legislative vote requirements; Income taxes
races.description: Require a two-thirds vote of both legislative chambers to pass a bill that would increase the individual or corporate income tax rate

races.title: Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment
races.name: Kansas Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment
races.subject: Citizenship voting requirements
races.description: Amend the state constitution to state that only a citizen of the United States is eligible to vote

races.title: Limit Governor's Pardon Power and Commutations Near General Election Amendment
races.name: Kentucky Limit Governor's Pardon Power and Commutations Near General Election Amendment
races.subject: State executive powers and duties
races.description: Prohibit the governor from issuing a pardon or commuting a sentence 60 days prior to the gubernatorial election and until after the fifth Tuesday succeeding the election

races.title: Amendment 1
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 1, One-Time Transfer of Disabled Veteran Homestead Tax Exemption for Surviving Spouses Amendment
races.subject: Veterans policy; Property tax exemptions; Homestead tax exemptions
races.description: Allow the surviving spouse of a disabled veteran to transfer the homestead property tax exemption one time to a new homestead

races.title: Amendment 10
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 10, Tax Exemption for Rehabilitated Property Amendment
races.subject: Property taxes; Property tax exemptions
races.description: Authorize a tax exemption for derelict or blighted property that has been rehabilitated

races.title: Amendment 2
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 2, Property Tax Rate Limits Based on Existing Voter-Approved Maximums Amendment
races.subject: Property taxes; State legislative authority
races.description: Authorize taxing authorities to levy a millage at a rate above the rate set by the previous year's assessment of the maximum amount of taxable property within each parish, but below the maximum permitted by the state constitution

races.title: Amendment 3
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 3, Prohibit Post-Conviction Bail for Individuals Convicted of Assault Against Minors Amendment
races.subject: Bail policy; Criminal sentencing
races.description: Prohibit post-conviction bail for a defendant who is convicted of an aggravated offense against a victim who is a minor

races.title: Amendment 4
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 4, Gubernatorial Two-Term Lifetime Limit Amendment
races.subject: Executive official term limits
races.description: Change the gubernatorial term limit from two consecutive terms to a lifetime maximum of two terms

races.title: Amendment 5
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 5, Remove Payment Order Requirement for State Retirement System Unfunded Liability Amendment
races.subject: Public employee retirement funds
races.description: Remove the requirement that a state retirement system receiving nonrecurring state funds apply those funds to its oldest outstanding unfunded accrued liability first

races.title: Amendment 6
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 6, Property Tax Exemption for Seniors Amendment
races.subject: Property tax exemptions; Homestead tax exemptions; Property taxes
races.description: Authorize a property tax exemption up to $30,000 of assessed property value, increasing with age, from taxation for homeowners 65 and older who qualify for the income-based assessment freeze

races.title: Amendment 7
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 7, Use Public Funds for Drinking Water Utility Service Lines Amendment
races.subject: Drinking water systems; Pollution, waste, and recycling policy; Local government finance and taxes
races.description: Authorize the use of public funds for the maintenance of drinking water utility services lines affected by hazardous materials on property owned by utility customers

races.title: Amendment 8
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 8, Prohibit Property Expropriation by Foreign Adversaries Amendment
races.subject: Eminent domain policy
races.description: Prohibit expropriation of property by foreign adversaries or agents of a foreign adversary, as defined by law

races.title: Amendment 9
races.name: Louisiana Amendment 9, Raise Income Limit to $150,000 for Special Property Tax Assessment Amendment
races.subject: Property tax exemptions; Homestead tax exemptions
races.description: Raise the income limit to qualify for the property tax special assessment level from $100,000 to $150,000

races.title: Question 1
races.name: Maryland Question 1, State Employee Collective Bargaining and Budget Amendment
races.subject: Collective bargaining; Public works labor and contracting; Labor disputes and strikes
races.description: Require the budget submitted by the governor to provide for expenditures for wages, hours, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment provided by a memorandum of understanding that covers state employees and provides for statutory changes to collective bargaining for state employees, including requiring the selection of a neutral arbitrator and establishing a process of arbitration

races.title: Question 2
races.name: Maryland Question 2, Commission on Judicial Disabilities Vacancies Amendment
races.subject: State judiciary oversight
races.description: Allow the chair of the Commission on Judicial Disabilities to appoint former members to temporarily fill vacancies or allow the governor to appoint a substitute member or extend the term of an existing member

races.title: Question 3
races.name: Maryland Question 3, Provide That Nothing in State Constitution Establishes Criteria for Congressional Redistricting Amendment
races.subject: Redistricting policy
races.description: Provide that constitutional requirements for legislative districts apply only to state legislative districts and not to congressional districts

races.title: Question 1
races.name: Massachusetts Question 1, Public Records Requirements for Legislature and Governor’s Office Initiative
races.subject: Open meetings and public information
races.description: Make records held by the state legislature and the governor's office public records

races.title: Question 2
races.name: Massachusetts Question 2, Permit Collective Bargaining for Committee for Public Counsel Services Employees Initiative
races.subject: Collective bargaining
races.description: Permit employees of the Committee for Public Counsel Services (CPCS) to participate in collective bargaining practices

races.title: Question 3
races.name: Massachusetts Question 3, Top-Two Primary Elections Initiative
races.subject: Primary election systems
races.description: Eliminate political party primaries for state elections and create a single primary where candidates are listed regardless of their political party

races.title: Question 4
races.name: Massachusetts Question 4, Permit Same-Day Voter Registration Initiative
races.subject: Voter registration
races.description: Provide for same-day voter registration

races.title: Question 5
races.name: Massachusetts Question 5, Change State Tax Revenue Limit Initiative
races.subject: Revenue and spending limits
races.description: Change the limit of how much revenue the state can collect in a given year

races.title: Question 6
races.name: Massachusetts Question 6, Establish the Nature for All Fund Initiative
races.subject: Revenue allocation; Restricted-use funds; Parks, land, and natural area conservation
races.description: Create a fund for state money, titled the Nature for All Fund, that would be used to further efforts of nature conservation

races.title: Question 7
races.name: Massachusetts Question 7, Limit on Required Lot Size for Single-Family Homes Initiative
races.subject: Land use and development policy
races.description: Require cities and towns to allow single-family homes on residentially zoned lots that meet minimum standards of at least 5,000 square feet in area

races.title: Question 8
races.name: Massachusetts Question 8, Eliminate Recreational Marijuana Sales and Allow Limited Possession Initiative
races.subject: Drug crime policy; Marijuana laws
races.description: Repeal laws that permit the sale of recreational marijuana and the personal cultivation of cannabis in homes

races.title: Question 9
races.name: Massachusetts Question 9, Firearm Regulations Referendum
races.subject: Firearms policy
races.description: Uphold the legislation, An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws (H. 4885), passed in 2024

races.title: Proposal 1
races.name: Michigan Proposal 1, Constitutional Convention Question
races.subject: State constitutional conventions
races.description: Asks voters whether to hold a state constitutional convention

races.title: Proposal 2
races.name: Michigan Proposal 2, Utility and Government Contractor Campaign Finance Regulations Initiative
races.subject: Campaign finance
races.description: Prohibit certain organizations and individuals—such as regulated electric and gas utilities, contractors with over $250,000 annually in government contracts, and people and organizations with substantial connections to those utilities or contractors—from making direct or indirect contributions to those who run for office, and also provide further regulations for campaign finance laws and spending on political communications

races.title: Alter Investment and Distribution Policies for Permanent School Fund Amendment
races.name: Minnesota Alter Investment and Distribution Policies for Permanent School Fund Amendment
races.subject: Restricted-use funds; Public education funding
races.description: Change the administrative policies for investing and distributing the Minnesota Permanent School Fund

races.title: Amendment 3
races.name: Missouri Amendment 3, Prohibit Abortion and Gender Transition Procedures for Minors Amendment
races.subject: LGBTQ issues; Healthcare governance; Sex and gender issues; Abortion policy; Constitutional rights
races.description: Prohibit abortion in most cases, and prohibit gender transition procedures for minors under eighteen

races.title: Amendment 6
races.name: Missouri Amendment 6, Initiative and Referendum Powers and Legislative Change Requirements Amendment
races.subject: Ballot measure process; Initiative and referendum process
races.description: Prohibit the legislature from repealing or amending a citizen initiative unless at least 80% of both the House and Senate vote to refer a proposed change to the ballot, and voters then approve the change, prohibit the legislature from making changes to the citizen initiative and referendum process, among other changes

races.title: Amendment 7
races.name: Missouri Amendment 7, Creation of Show-Me Prosperity Investment Fund for State Tax Reduction and Elimination Amendment
races.subject: Tax and revenue administration; Restricted-use funds
races.description: Create a permanent public endowment fund managed by the state to generate revenue, and use the earnings to eliminate state-imposed taxes when sufficient to replace them

races.title: Amendment 8
races.name: Missouri Amendment 8, Require Election of County Sheriffs Amendment
races.subject: Law enforcement officers and departments; Local government officials and elections
races.description: Require the election of county sheriffs

races.title: Proposition A
races.name: Missouri Proposition A, Congressional Map Referendum
races.subject: Redistricting policy
races.description: Uphold House Bill 1, which provided for new congressional districts ("yes" upholds, and "no" repeals)

races.title: CI-132
races.name: Montana CI-132, Require Nonpartisan Judicial Elections Initiative
races.subject: State judicial selection
races.description: Add a new section to the Montana Constitution to require that all judicial elections are nonpartisan

races.title: CI-133
races.name: Montana CI-133, Add Right to Initiative and Referendum Power to Declaration of Rights Amendment
races.subject: Constitutional rights; Initiative and referendum process
races.description: Add the power of initiative and referendum to the state's Declaration of Rights

races.title: I-194
races.name: Montana I-194, Exclude Political Spending from Artificial Persons’ Charter Powers Initiative
races.subject: Campaign finance; Business regulations
races.description: Prohibit artificial persons, as defined in the initiative, from contributing to campaigns, ballot measure elections, or political parties

races.title: Constitutional Amendment 1
races.name: Nebraska Constitutional Amendment 1, Change State Legislative Term Limits from Two to Three Consecutive Terms Amendment
races.subject: State legislative term limits
races.description: Change the legislative term limit from two consecutive four-year terms to three

races.title: Initiative Measure 440
races.name: Nebraska Initiative Measure 440, Allow Laws Authorizing Online Sports Wagering Constitutional Amendment
races.subject: Gambling policy
races.description: Authorize laws to govern sports betting

races.title: Initiative Measure 441
races.name: Nebraska Initiative Measure 441, Allow and Regulate Online Sports Wagering Initiative
races.subject: Gambling policy
races.description: Authorize online sports betting in the state and authorize the state gaming commission to adopt rules and regulations governing the gaming operators

races.title: Initiative Measure 442
races.name: Nebraska Initiative Measure 442, Sex Requirement for School and College Sports Initiative
races.subject: Sex and gender issues; LGBTQ issues; Athletics and sports; Public education governance
races.description: Require schools designate sports team as male, female, or co-ed and prohibit male participation on female sports teams
